# factory_setup_v1

A subject for the `factory-setup` eval: the Engineer exactly as the desktop
first run creates it (the shipped Setup prompt and self-config grant, agents
tools, sessions tool, read-only query and the engineer-mailbox surface), with
file tools and no host bash, as an embedded trial requires. Its kickoff
variant is under `factory/`; the trial's stage prompt tells the Engineer to
read `factory/kickoff.md`.
